title: Timeline component for activity and history
description: Vertical Timeline with indicators, titles, and descriptions for activity feeds, order tracking, and changelogs in React and Next.js. Includes optional animated entrances.

intro: Timelines render ordered events down a connected vertical track. Each TimelineItem carries an indicator plus a content slot for a title and supporting description, while the connector line is drawn automatically between items.

faqs.question: How is the connector line drawn?
faqs.answer: Each item except the last renders an absolutely-positioned connector that runs from its indicator down to the next item. The last item drops its bottom padding so the track ends cleanly.

faqs.question: Can the timeline animate on scroll?
faqs.answer: Import TimelineItem from the /animated entry to get a staggered fade-and-rise entrance that respects prefers-reduced-motion. The static entry ships without framer-motion.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Indicators inherit a themeable appearance and size from the Timeline root, and any item can override its own appearance. Every color is a --zui-timeline-* CSS variable with a paired dark-mode value.
